sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
Our order history for this part shows 4.12 EUR (po:4500010043-10) against 4.39 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014467-10).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Please understand that as a matter of company policy, we do not provide detailed internal cost breakdowns. The historical prices you referenced do not reflect our current operational costs and market conditions. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Thank you for your response and the offer of faster payment terms; we can offer €4.87 per unit for a 24-month contract with 14 days payment terms. 

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to present our offer with a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Our commercial management has reviewed your request and the binding volume commitment of 20,000 pieces per year. This volume is already fully reflected in our calculation, leaving minimal room for further adjustments. We can offer a slight concession to €4.86 per unit for the 14-day payment term on a 24-month contract. Beside this alternative, we can offer a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We have thoroughly reviewed the forecast data and checked the volume change data you cited. It holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position, and this reflects our firm position.

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, for a 24-month contract with 60 days payment terms, we can offer €4.91 per unit.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

This offer remains valid for 7 days. We appreciate your business and look forward to hearing from you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
